import numpy as np

# Sample the grasp pose for the red cube
red_grasp_pose = sample_grasp_pose('red cube')

# Get the pose of the green cube
green_pose = get_object_pose('green cube', return_bbox_extent=True)

# Calculate the placement position
green_center_z = green_pose[0][2]
green_extent = green_pose[2]
red_extent = get_object_pose('red cube', return_bbox_extent=True)[2]
place_z = green_center_z + green_extent[2]/2 + red_extent[2]/2

# Open the gripper before approaching
open_gripper()

# Approach the red cube for grasping
goto_pose(red_grasp_pose[0], red_grasp_pose[1], z_approach=0.1)

# Grasp the red cube
close_gripper()

# Lift the red cube to a safe height
lift_pos = red_grasp_pose[0] + np.array([0, 0, 0.2])
goto_pose(lift_pos, red_grasp_pose[1])

# Place the red cube on top of the green cube
place_pos = np.array([green_pose[0][0], green_pose[0][1], place_z])
goto_pose(place_pos, red_grasp_pose[1], z_approach=0.1)

# Open the gripper
open_gripper()
